🚨 Now Hiring: Sr. Full Stack Developer 🚨
We’re looking for a Sr. Full Stack Developer with strong experience in:
🔹 Java & Microservices
 🔹 AWS
 🔹 JavaScript
 🔹 React & Angular
 🔹 Python
 🔹 AI / Generative AI

📍 Location: Hybrid – Rockville, MD or McLean, VA
 🏠 Locals preferred
 🚗 Relocation candidates accepted – candidates must be 100% committed and certain about relocating
 💼 Contract: W2 (H1B Transfers Accepted)

Interested? Please share your updated resume to mohammad@acetech.group or DM me or tag someone who may be a great fit!

comment: For senior full stack roles, the real differentiator is often production ownership—designing scalable services, handling cloud costs, and mentoring teams—not just the breadth of the tech stack.
